title: Meta says it is "explicitly separating" Quest VR from its Worlds platform, making Worlds "almost exclusively mobile", letting it better compete with Roblox (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: Meta says it is “explicitly separating” Quest VR from its Worlds platform, making Worlds “almost exclusively mobile”, letting it better compete with Roblox — Horizon Worlds is now going to be a platform that's ‘almost exclusively mobile.’
contentText:
Jay Peters / The Verge :

Meta says it is “explicitly separating” Quest VR from its Worlds platform, making Worlds “almost exclusively mobile”, letting it better compete with Roblox   —  ﻿Horizon Worlds is now going to be a platform that's ‘almost exclusively mobile.’
